lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows extending from the posterior of the gills towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like pattern of luminance maxima across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to lower luminance (shadow) on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Four remoras (Echeneidae) are visible in the ventral-lateral proximity: two trailing the mid-section and two positioned near the pectoral fin base.
